grantBoundary.ordering: The same IMMEDIATE transaction acquires the bounded observation publication view after writer backlog, validates active sampler/generation/epoch, sequence and pressure-field age, then persists decision/permit before commit under the fence. Native work stays on MeterWorker.
grantBoundary.launchOrdering: READY has a distinct native deadline of at most 2000 ms/remaining freshness. The daemon drops the publication lease at that deadline even during a partial ACK read. A further bounded 2000 ms cleanup grace accepts only the matching same-connection ACK; it authorizes no spawn. Owner-verified Unspawned retraction runs on the single writer after dropping the lease. The CLI retries only after confirmed {}; Started, disconnect, malformed ACK or lost cleanup confirmation cannot replay a possible execution.
